current_scene: Suncoil Watch outer courtyard secured after combat and evidence sweep
current_location: Emberglass region — Suncoil Watch outer courtyard and opened sealed descent
last_sync_note: Session 1, Turn 8 resolved. DevilMedlar kept the rescued Copper Finch courier restrained as a precaution, adding leg restraints while leaving the existing wrist restraints in place until complicity can be assessed. All four defeated hostiles were found alive, disarmed, searched, and securely bound using site cordage and wagon tie-downs rather than party rope. The courier carries a Copper Finch employee tag identifying Rian Kest, human male age 28, a routine route ledger, 4 sp, and an ordinary utility knife; no hostile token, Archive correspondence, hidden route sheet, or other obvious incriminating item was found, but he is not cleared. Senpai's Perception with Keen Hearing and Smell used advantage, rolled 3 and 12, total 15, finding no additional person in the immediately accessible above-ground ruins but detecting recent human scent and lamp-oil traces toward the old descent. A thorough site search found one Gravelark Salvage relic crate marked for Orin Pell as crate 5 of 6, proving at least one of Pell's two missing crates reached Suncoil Watch. The opened Meridian Archive dispatch case was recovered with six of eight indexed folios still present; the Suncoil Watch lower-access survey and comparative seal-geometry folios are missing. A folded instruction on the former hostage-taker orders the Finch wagon taken off-road, everything searched, the blue case prioritized over coin, one courier kept alive until the old stair is confirmed, and the case plus stone crate brought to the Watch; it is signed only 'K'. Senpai's Arcana 19+2=21 established that the opened Suncoil Watch descent and the Cinderwash stone fragments use the same broader Suncoil ward tradition, while not proving a physical tunnel connection; the threshold's old active ward is currently broken or dormant and no active magical trap was identified at the immediate entrance. Compact evidence was retained, bulky property and ordinary weapons/cargo were secured for authorized recovery, and suspect currency was bagged as evidence rather than added to party funds. DevilMedlar remains 5/9 HP with Dragon Ki 0/2 and Radiant Breath 2/2; Senpai remains 9/9 HP with both spell slots. Both gained 20 XP and reached 300 XP, triggering level-2 advancement before further exploration.
